title.value: Posterior inference of Hi-C contact frequency through sampling
title.justification: The paper discusses a method for posterior inference of Hi-C contact frequency, specifically detailing the HiCSampler approach.
title.quote: Zhang et al. (2024), Posterior inference of Hi-C contact frequency through sampling. Front. Bioinform. 3:1285828. doi: 10.3389/fbinf.2023.1285828

extractions.description: The paper presents HiCSampler, a method for inferring the posterior distribution of interaction frequencies in Hi-C contact maps. It leverages Markov random field models and MCMC sampling to address uncertainty in Hi-C data, enabling more accurate downstream genomic analyses.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on statistical methodologies for genomic data analysis, specifically Hi-C contact maps, without a direct connection to eco-responsible AI applications or topics related to climate change, sustainability, or environmental considerations.
primary_category.quote: Hi-C is one of the most widely used approaches to study three-dimensional genome conformations. Contacts captured by a Hi-C experiment are represented in a contact frequency matrix.

secondary_categories.justification: The content of the paper is fundamentally about computational biology and bioinformatics, without secondary implications or discussions related to eco-responsible AI or environmental sustainability.
secondary_categories.quote: The outcome of a Hi-C experiment is a read count matrix o, whose rows and columns correspond to pre-specified genomic loci.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no specific sub-category within the eco-responsible AI framework that aligns with the content of this paper, which deals with bioinformatics methods for genomic data.
primary_sub_category.quote: HiCSampler, a Markov random field (MRF) model that provides posterior inference of the Hi-C interaction frequency.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The topics covered in the paper are purely scientific, dealing with genomic data processing, with no direct ties to environmental or sustainability issues.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: HiCSampler takes the Hi-C contact map, bias vector inferred with ICE normalization, and model parameters as input and outputs a set of interaction frequency matrices.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is centrally focused on methods for improving analysis in genomic studies, specifically Hi-C contact maps, which fits within a computational biology and bioinformatics scope that is separate from eco-responsible AI.
new_primary_category.quote: HiCSampler models the interaction frequencies by taking their structural dependencies into consideration and approximates their posterior distribution.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The novel sub-category is proposed to reflect the specific focus on analyzing genomic data, which the paper thoroughly addresses.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We present the Hi-C interaction frequency sampler (HiCSampler) that reliably infers the posterior distribution of the interaction frequency for a given Hi-C contact map.
